sentences.text:
Through:
 CORAM:
 HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE SANJAY DHAR, JUDGE  ORDER 14-08-2024 The petitioner has challenged FIR No.84/2024 for offences under Section 420 IPC registered with Police Station Sadar Srinagar.

It is contended by the learned counsel for the petitioner that the fact that subject matter of the agreement to sell between petitioner and respondent no.2 was mortgaged to Jammu and Kashmir Bank Limited is clearly disclosed in the agreement to sell executed by them on 27.08.2022,
therefore, there was no deception practiced by the petitioner upon respondent no.2.

It has been further contended that it is the respondent no.2 who failed to liquidate the balance amount to the petitioner, as a result of which, the deal could not mature and in-fact the cheque issued by respondent no.2 in favour of petitioner was bounced and the same became subject matter of a complaint filed by the petitioner against the said respondent.
Issue notice to respondents, subject to the petitioner taking necessary steps within a week's time.
Notice be issued to respondent no.2 through concerned police station also.
In the meanwhile, the investigation in the impugned FIR shall remain stayed.
